destination.title: Compactification, supersymmetry and vacuum dynamics
destination.question: How do compactification ingredients, supersymmetry and its breaking shape vacuum structure and effective interactions, and which source-specific tests establish stability, control and physical consequences?
destination.summary: A proposed discovery family with separate construction, stabilization, control, stability, spectrum and cosmological directions. Numerical batches retain provenance; existing scoped questions supply public routes.

systems: Compactification-derived and independently studied supergravity models
Rigid supersymmetric and gauge theories through explicit comparison or methodological routes
targets: Vacuum geometry, energy and candidate stationary configurations
Moduli stabilization and compatibility of construction ingredients
Effective actions, corrections, retained fields and quantitative control
Scalar stability, decay and thermal survival
Cosmological evolution and source-defined vacuum statistics
regimes: Classical, perturbative and nonperturbative mechanisms remain distinct

Finite parameters and asymptotic limits require separate assessments

sources.title: Moduli stabilisation and inflation in type IIB/F-theory

evidence.text: Can perturbative corrections in a type IIB/F-theory effective model stabilize Kähler moduli at positive vacuum energy, and can an additional Fayet–Iliopoulos contribution permit volume-modulus slow-roll inflation?

sources.title: Open problems on classical de Sitter solutions

evidence.text: How do intersecting source sets change the existence restrictions derived for parallel sources?

sources.title: On classical de Sitter solutions and parametric control

evidence.text: Can specific type IIB de Sitter compactifications satisfy flux, source and lattice quantization together with classical string control, and can a scaling improve control parametrically or evade proposed asymptotic de Sitter obstructions?

sources.title: De Sitter string vacua from supersymmetric D terms

evidence.text: Can a modulus-dependent supersymmetric D-term replace the KKLT anti-D3 uplift, producing a metastable de Sitter vacuum with spontaneous supersymmetry breaking, and can the mechanism extend to heterotic strings?

sources.title: Jumping Through Loops: On Soft Terms from Large Volume Compactifications

evidence.text: Are omitted bulk and localized terms suppressed in hierarchical LVS, and can BPS charge–tension matching forbid candidate induced potentials?

sources.title: Jumping Through Loops: On Soft Terms from Large Volume Compactifications

evidence.text: Can calculations or symmetries exclude mixed-cycle and higher-loop terms that are less suppressed than the retained α′ effect?

sources.title: Warping and supersymmetry breaking

evidence.text: Can warping turn the high energy associated with an antibrane flux dual into a hierarchically small supersymmetry-breaking scale while maintaining a controlled, stabilized compactification?

sources.title: SUSY Breaking at the Tip of Throat and Mirage Mediation

evidence.text: Can infrared brane supersymmetry breaking generate viable ultraviolet visible soft terms when gauge-coupling moduli were first stabilized supersymmetrically by nonperturbative dynamics?

sources.title: SUSY Breaking at the Tip of Throat and Mirage Mediation

evidence.text: How do stabilization and localization determine the relative strengths of modulus and supergravity transmission of supersymmetry breaking, and therefore the visible soft masses?

sources.title: Low Energy Supersymmetry from Non-Geometry

evidence.text: Can non-geometric fluxes generate an exponentially small gravitino mass while retaining a high string scale and stabilizing all moduli, by first constructing perturbative W=0 Minkowski vacua and then introducing small non-perturbative effects?

sources.title: Low Energy Supersymmetry from Non-Geometry

evidence.text: Can a non-geometric flux sector generate the small constants needed by an ISS supersymmetry-breaking sector while stabilizing its gauge-coupling modulus perturbatively?

sources.title: More about F-term uplifting

evidence.text: Can an independently stabilized, heavier modulus prevent the large relative X displacement induced by a modulus-dependent uplifting tadpole?

sources.title: Systematics of String Loop Corrections in Type IIB Calabi-Yau Flux Compactifications

evidence.text: When can string-loop corrections be neglected in moduli stabilization? The survey distinguishes corrections that bound a mechanism's validity from corrections that generate its stabilizing potential, and it warns that conclusions drawn from a few-modulus model need not survive additional flat directions.

sources.title: Moduli stabilization in (string) model building: Gauge fluxes and loops

evidence.text: Can gauge-flux D-terms, a Scherk-Schwarz source for a constant superpotential, and gaugino condensation consistently stabilize the dilaton and volume moduli, and do flux-induced quantum corrections preserve the resulting minimum?

sources.title: Stabilizing moduli with thermal matter and nonperturbative effects

evidence.text: Can gaugino-condensation stabilization of the dilaton coexist with radion stabilization by enhanced-symmetry momentum/winding strings, without their combined dynamics destabilizing either modulus? The paper presents a preliminary answer under simplifying approximations.

sources.title: No metastable de Sitter vacua in N=2 supergravity with only hypermultiplets

evidence.text: Can four-dimensional N=2 supergravity with only hypermultiplet matter admit locally stable vacua with spontaneously broken supersymmetry, particularly Minkowski or de Sitter vacua?

sources.title: Metastable SUSY Breaking, de Sitter Moduli Stabilisation and Kahler Moduli Inflation

evidence.text: How do dynamical gauge couplings, charged moduli and anomalous-U(1) D-terms modify ISS-type supersymmetry breaking, and can the resulting N=1 effective theory support controlled de Sitter stabilization, soft terms and Kähler-modulus inflation?

sources.title: F-term Uplift in Heterotic M-theory

evidence.text: Can vector bundle moduli provide sufficient F-term uplift to stabilize supersymmetry-breaking Minkowski or de Sitter vacua in heterotic M-theory, including when the tree-level superpotential is constant?

sources.title: SUSY Breaking in Local String/F-Theory Models

evidence.text: How strongly does bulk LARGE-volume supersymmetry breaking generate gravity and anomaly mediated soft terms on local Standard Model/GUT branes, and what follows for gauge mediation and the cosmological moduli problem?

sources.title: Classical and Quantum SUSY Breaking Effects in IIB Local Models

evidence.text: How do classical soft terms, flavor violation, Weyl-anomaly contributions and gaugino mediation constrain supersymmetry breaking in local type IIB Large Volume Scenario models?

sources.title: Universal de Sitter solutions at tree-level

evidence.text: Can classical four-dimensional de Sitter solutions of type IIA compactification be constructed directly in ten dimensions using only universal SU(3)-structure forms and torsion classes, and can an explicit geometry satisfy the resulting conditions?

sources.title: Supersymmetry breaking branes on solvmanifolds and de Sitter vacua in string theory

evidence.text: Can classical geometric type IIA compactifications with sources breaking bulk supersymmetry yield ten-dimensional de Sitter solutions, and can generalized first-order equations simplify their construction?

sources.title: Kähler moduli inflation and WMAP7

evidence.text: Do effective single-field Kähler-moduli inflation potentials from explicit type-IIB large-volume compactifications produce sufficient e-folding, a suitable scalar spectral index and suitable running relative to the historical WMAP7 ranges? A simpler exponential toy potential is also analyzed.

sources.title: On the Effective Description of Large Volume Compactifications

evidence.text: When does freezing the dilaton and complex-structure multiplets in two-step Large Volume Scenario stabilization remain a reliable approximately supersymmetric description after adding matter and gauge interactions, despite lacking a mass hierarchy?

sources.title: A sufficient condition for de Sitter vacua in type IIB string theory

evidence.text: Can Kähler uplifting yield an analytic sufficient condition, expressed through flux and compactification data, for metastable de Sitter vacua with small positive vacuum energy, spontaneously broken supersymmetry and stabilized moduli?

sources.title: Anomalous U(1) Mediation in Large Volume Compactification

evidence.text: Does anomalous U(1)A mediation produce soft SUSY-breaking terms independent of detailed moduli mixing in LVS, and when do mixing-dependent F- and D-term contributions dominate the resulting MSSM spectrum?

sources.title: Poly-instanton Inflation

evidence.text: Can poly-instanton effects generate viable single-field inflation from a fibre Kähler modulus while the total volume remains stabilized and perturbative corrections remain small enough to avoid the η-problem?

sources.title: Superpotential de-sequestering in string models

evidence.text: When do geometrically distant moduli-stabilising effects or hidden scalar vevs induce visible-sector Yukawa couplings with new flavour structure, undermining sequestering and contributing to flavour violation?

sources.title: Moduli Stabilization and Inflationary Cosmology with Poly-Instantons in Type IIB Orientifolds

evidence.text: Can poly-instanton corrections stabilize a Wilson-line divisor's Kähler modulus in a controlled LARGE volume model and generate viable slow-roll inflation when that modulus is displaced?

sources.title: Simple metastable de Sitter vacua in N=2 gauged supergravity

evidence.text: Can minimal N=2 gauged supergravity with one hypermultiplet and one vector multiplet admit metastable de Sitter vacua without constant Fayet–Iliopoulos terms or non-Abelian gauging, and how does the answer depend on V/m_{3/2}²?

sources.title: Jumping Through Loops: On Soft Terms from Large Volume Compactifications

evidence.text: The proposed diagnostic compares a candidate DBI-induced tension with a corresponding Chern–Simons charge term under BPS assumptions. Applying it to the listed flux–curvature terms remains heuristic.

sources.title: Warping and supersymmetry breaking

evidence.text: Separate the UV boundary and localized interior terms by integration by parts. Compare complex structures at fixed flux labels, axio-dilaton, Kähler zero mode and geometric Λ0, allowing the nonconstant warp profile and tΛ to vary. Any fixed leading bulk normalization is a separate approximation.

sources.title: SUSY Breaking at the Tip of Throat and Mirage Mediation

evidence.text: Stabilize heavy fields, estimate their auxiliary components, eliminate fluctuations and insert their vacuum values into light couplings. Here S, U, X and Z are removed while the Goldstino, T and C remain.

sources.title: Low Energy Supersymmetry from Non-Geometry

evidence.text: Combine a world-volume-flux D-term with non-perturbative stabilization, then minimize over charged open fields. A viable uplift requires a surviving positive contribution at the small vacuum-energy scale rather than automatic D-flatness or a Planck-scale energy.

sources.title: More about F-term uplifting

evidence.text: Integrate out heavy modes near the supersymmetry-breaking configuration and retain the leading quartic Kähler correction together with a linear effective superpotential.

sources.title: Systematics of String Loop Corrections in Type IIB Calabi-Yau Flux Compactifications

evidence.text: Estimate the surviving Coleman–Weinberg powers using a gravitino mass and a sector cutoff, then compare them with the corrected Kähler potential. The procedure tests parametric consistency and must be accompanied by an effective-theory hierarchy check.

sources.title: Metastable spontaneous breaking of N=2 supersymmetry

evidence.text: Can rigid N=2 supersymmetry break spontaneously in metastable vacua without constant Fayet–Iliopoulos terms, using only one hypermultiplet and one Abelian vector multiplet? What scalar-mass bounds follow, and what can be inferred about an extension to de Sitter supergravity?

sources.title: $ \overline{\textrm{D}3} $-branes and gaugino condensation

evidence.text: Do supersymmetry-breaking fluxes sourced by anti-D3 branes in a warped Klebanov–Strassler throat generate D7 gaugino masses large enough to invalidate Kähler-moduli stabilization by gaugino condensation?

destination.title: Flux compactifications, effective dynamics and vacuum questions

Overlapping review batches remain provenance rather than mandatory public branches.

sources.title: Beyond Twisted Tori

evidence.text: Which flux and localized-source combinations define consistent compactifications and effective theories when geometrical flux changes the internal topology? The paper studies this question classically, principally for type-IIA orientifolds with four-dimensional supersymmetry.

sources.title: Symmetric fluxes and small tadpoles

evidence.text: Can symmetric flux choices make many-field type IIB vacuum equations tractable while stabilizing many real moduli with small D3 tadpole, and how close do controlled large-complex-structure examples approach the refined Tadpole Conjecture?

sources.title: Flux compactifications in string theory: A Comprehensive review

evidence.text: How do closed-string fluxes support four-dimensional type II vacua, constrain internal geometry, generate effective potentials and stabilize moduli? The review also examines corrections, proposed de Sitter constructions and statistical distributions of vacua.

sources.title: Toroidal orientifolds in IIA with general NS-NS fluxes

evidence.text: What is the R-R charge lattice when NS-NS coefficients are logarithms of integral monodromies rather than integer inherited-form coefficients?

sources.title: Beyond Twisted Tori

evidence.text: Do nongeometric fluxes possess source solitons analogous to NS5 and KK5 objects, and can their contributions relax the corresponding flux constraints? The paper poses this as an unresolved extension.

sources.title: From ten to four and back again: How to generalize the geometry

evidence.text: Can warped flux backgrounds be described by four-dimensional supersymmetry data without first identifying a reliable finite set of light fields?

sources.title: Lectures on Nongeometric Flux Compactifications

evidence.text: How does T-duality enlarge the set of Type II flux compactifications beyond ordinary target-space manifolds? The lectures study backgrounds generated from NS-NS three-form flux, rather than attempting a classification of all nongeometric conformal field theories.

sources.title: Lectures on Nongeometric Flux Compactifications

evidence.text: What happens to quantized NS-NS flux under repeated fiber T-duality? The review uses a flat T³ with integer H-flux as a simple local illustration whose monodromies can be computed explicitly.

sources.title: TASI Lectures on the Cosmological Constant

evidence.text: Can many moderately charged fluxes provide a dense vacuum spectrum while retaining large transition energies? The model separates closeness in vacuum energy from adjacency in the integer flux grid.

sources.title: D-terms from generalized NS-NS fluxes in type II

evidence.text: How do generalized NS-NS fluxes enter four-dimensional N=1 type-II orientifold theories, and which fluxes charge R-R axions and generate D-term scalar potentials? The motivation is a richer potential for moduli stabilization and possible de Sitter or inflationary applications.

sources.title: Flux Compactifications, Gauge Algebras and De Sitter

evidence.text: Which N=4 gauge algebras actually arise from the considered geometric and nongeometric flux compactifications, and can their flux dictionary realize the gaugings then known to possess de Sitter solutions?

sources.title: Applications of an exact counting formula in the Bousso-Polchinski Landscape

evidence.text: How can BP flux vacua be counted when the usual volume estimate fails, and what does improved counting imply for low-Λ abundances, typical flux occupation and estimates of the minimum nonnegative cosmological constant?

sources.title: Smeared versus localised sources in flux compactifications

evidence.text: When do flux vacua constructed using smeared orientifolds or D-branes survive source localisation, and how does the answer depend on BPS relations and the resulting warping, dilaton and RR-field corrections?

sources.title: Charting the landscape of N=4 flux compactifications

evidence.text: Which SO(3)-invariant vacua occur in isotropic Z2×Z2 flux compactifications with one set of sources, and which remain stable after including the full N=4 scalar spectrum?

sources.title: A geometric action for non-geometric fluxes

evidence.text: What geometric interpretation can be assigned to non-geometric Q and R fluxes, and can they enter a higher-dimensional action with manifest diffeomorphism covariance?

sources.title: (Non-)commutative closed string on T-dual toroidal backgrounds

evidence.text: Does the Q-flux T-dual of a three-torus with H-flux exhibit closed-string coordinate noncommutativity, supporting the conjecture that the coordinate commutator is proportional to a winding-cycle integral of Q?

sources.title: $\beta$-supergravity: a ten-dimensional theory with non-geometric fluxes, and its geometric framework

evidence.text: Can a ten-dimensional NSNS reformulation identify non-geometric Q- and R-fluxes, explain their geometric structures, and provide an origin for some four-dimensional gauged supergravities?

sources.title: New Examples of Flux Vacua

evidence.text: Which geometric type IIA and massive IIA Minkowski flux backgrounds arise by T-dualizing toroidal type IIB orientifolds, and how do their fluxes, localized-source tadpoles and equations of motion evade the compactification no-go obstruction?

sources.title: On finiteness of Type IIB compactifications: Magnetized branes on elliptic Calabi-Yau threefolds

evidence.text: Do Ramond–Ramond tadpole cancellation and necessary N=1 supersymmetry conditions bound magnetized D9/D5 configurations uniformly over large-volume Kähler moduli, with explicitly computable topological bounds?

sources.title: On the Flux Vacua in F-theory Compactifications

evidence.text: Can mirror-symmetry data including brane deformations produce F-theory flux vacua that stabilize all complex-structure fields near a large-complex-structure point?

sources.title: TASI Lectures on Remnants from the String Landscape

evidence.text: Could population and observer selection across many vacua explain some observed fine-tunings?

sources.title: On Missing Bianchi Identities in Cohomology Formulation

evidence.text: Which quadratic NS-NS flux constraints are missed by the known cohomology formulation of type IIA Bianchi identities, and can their structure be expressed using topological data for applications beyond toroidal orientifolds?

sources.title: On brane gaugino condensates in 10d

evidence.text: Determine how compact geometry changes cancellation of a localized codimension-two source when bulk flux periods are quantized.

sources.title: Cobordism Classes and the Swampland

evidence.text: Which spin backgrounds remain allowed after including the heterotic B-field constraint? The distinction depends on Yang–Mills flux and fivebrane sources.

sources.title: Rigid nongeometric orientifolds and the swampland

evidence.text: Does harmonic nilpotency constrain this type IIA orientifold? The parity projection removes the even-form flux sector, and rigidity trivializes the remaining antisymmetric relation.

sources.title: Rigid nongeometric orientifolds and the swampland

evidence.text: Do the additional toroidal constraints persist on generic rigid Calabi–Yau orientifolds and obstruct simultaneous H,Q flux there?

sources.title: Asymptotic Flux Compactifications and the Swampland

evidence.text: Do restrictions on flux vacua and axion dynamics survive beyond weak coupling and large volume? The paper approaches this question through four-form flux potentials near boundaries of Calabi–Yau complex-structure moduli space, including boundaries at finite distance.

sources.title: Asymptotic Flux Compactifications and the Swampland

evidence.text: How does primitive internal four-form flux generate a complex-structure potential? The M/F-theory expression combines a moduli-dependent Hodge norm with a topological flux pairing constrained by the curvature tadpole.

sources.title: Classification of discrete modular symmetries in Type IIB flux vacua

evidence.text: Which modular subgroups survive three-form fluxes on toroidal orientifolds, and how do flux quantization, tadpole cancellation and magnetized D-branes constrain their realization?

sources.title: The web of swampland conjectures and the TCC bound

evidence.text: How should external four-form flux components enter a four-dimensional scalar potential obtained from a type-II compactification?

sources.title: Toroidal orientifolds in IIA with general NS-NS fluxes

evidence.text: Transport reference R-R polyforms, differentiate, and match operator coefficients. Restrict outputs to one lower/base index per flux; unrestricted generalized fluxes and R flux are not supplied.

sources.title: Beyond Twisted Tori

sources.title: From ten to four and back again: How to generalize the geometry

evidence.text: Track the involution through the pairing integrands, compare their parity with the volume form, and normalize a covering-space integral by its overcounting factor. The explicit potential formulas and component action of α are needed to reproduce the sign check.

sources.title: Lectures on Nongeometric Flux Compactifications

evidence.text: Enumerate admissible flux vectors, solve their consistency conditions, eliminate S and U, and numerically solve for physical τ roots. Record g_s and Λ while keeping root-finding, duality identifications and string-theory validity as separate tasks.

sources.title: TASI Lectures on the Cosmological Constant

evidence.text: Approximate a thin energy shell by its continuum volume and compare that volume with a lattice cell. The operation estimates configuration abundance, with arithmetic and degeneracy checks needed for claims about actual nearby energy levels.

sources.title: D-terms from generalized NS-NS fluxes in type II

evidence.text: The proposed R-R gauge transformation C_RR→C_RR+𝒟Λ identifies axion shifts and electric/magnetic charges. D-terms follow from D_A=i(∂_I K)δ_Aφⁱ for gauge-neutral W. In IIB the common superpotential expression is W=∫(F3+𝒟Φev_c)∧Ω.

sources.title: Toroidal orientifolds in IIA with general NS-NS fluxes

evidence.text: Which generalized NS-NS flux configurations admit consistent four-dimensional IIA orientifold descriptions and useful moduli potentials?

destinations.title: Which flux and localized-source combinations define consistent compactifications and effective theories when geometrical flux changes the internal topology? The paper studies this question classically, principally for type-IIA orientifolds with four-dimensional supersymmetry.

Do restrictions on flux vacua and axion dynamics survive beyond weak coupling and large volume? The paper approaches this question through four-form flux potentials near boundaries of Calabi–Yau complex-structure moduli space, including boundaries at finite distance.

Can symmetric flux choices make many-field type IIB vacuum equations tractable while stabilizing many real moduli with small D3 tadpole, and how close do controlled large-complex-structure examples approach the refined Tadpole Conjecture?

How do closed-string fluxes support four-dimensional type II vacua, constrain internal geometry, generate effective potentials and stabilize moduli? The review also examines corrections, proposed de Sitter constructions and statistical distributions of vacua.
